title: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder 5.5-Inch Solid Brass | Autumn Sparkle | Vanity Top Accessories | Allied Brass
short_title: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder 5.5-Inch, Autumn Sparkle
description:
Keep toilet paper within easy reach when wall space is limited—this vanity top toilet tissue holder adds convenient storage right on the counter in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round.

Highlights
- Save wall space in smaller bathrooms with a countertop vanity top design
- Keep a toilet paper roll accessible beside the sink for everyday use
- Choose long-lasting durability with solid brass construction
- Coordinate your look with the vanity top accessories collection and multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 5.5 x 6 x 5 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 12 x 10 x 6 in.
- Shipping weight: 5 lbs
- Limited lifetime warranty
- Assembled in the USA
